item.title: Folding Carton Pillow Box with Curved Design for Luxury Gifts
item.description:

The pillow-shaped folding carton with its signature curved silhouette brings sculptural elegance to gift packaging — far beyond the conventional rectangular box. Manufactured by Guangdong Bincai Color Printing Co., Ltd. — ISO 9001:2015 and FSC certified — this box is produced on our Heidelberg 7+1 UV offset press for razor-sharp CMYK registration with simultaneous gold foil hot stamping. Guangdong Bincai Color Printing’s recyclable kraft folding carton for eco-friendly food packaging delivers sustainable protection with brand-forward printing. FSC certified kraft paperboard, soy-based inks, and water-based adhesives ensure full recyclability and industrial compostability. Applications

  • Bakery & Confectionery: Artisan bread, cookies, chocolates, pastries with food-safe inks
  • Takeaway & Delivery: Eco-conscious restaurant to-go packaging with brand printing
  • Farmers Markets: Honey jars, jam, preserves, handmade goods — rustic kraft aesthetic
  • Coffee & Tea: Specialty coffee bags, loose-leaf tea cartons, gift sets
  • Meal Kit & Subscription: Dry ingredient compartments, recipe card inserts
  • Health & Wellness: Supplement cartons, protein bars, wellness product packaging

  • Styles: Tuck-top (straight/reverse), auto-lock bottom, gable top, sleeve, window carton
  • Sizes: Fully custom — 60×40×20mm to 400×300×120mm
  • Materials: FSC kraft paperboard (200–350gsm), recycled kraft, solid bleached sulfate
  • Printing: Soy-based CMYK offset, Pantone spot colors, food-safe indirect contact certified
  • Finishes: Aqueous matte/gloss coating, blind embossing, registered emboss, no-plastic policy
  • Windows: PLA biodegradable film window, die-cut open window, or no-window
  • Inserts: Die-cut kraft dividers, molded pulp trays, corrugated partitions

Adhesive Water-based PVA, solvent-free, pH neutral, repulpable
Coating Aqueous (water-based) — maintains recyclability
Daily Capacity 1.7 million color boxes + 220,000+ gift boxes

  • ISO 9001:2015 certified — documented QC at every production stage

  • Print quality: spectrophotometer density check every 500 sheets, registration ±0.15mm

  • Food safety: soy inks certified for indirect food contact, no migratory substances
